source_policy: 保源气功对金创药/人参/治疗武功/武功耗内功的作用范围，精确每级系数/合成/取整为项目采用。名字运气疗伤的被动不是医师同名可施放治疗技能。

potion_effects.owner: potion actual consumer passive grade at accepted use, not merchant or teammate healer
potion_effects.formula: floor(base_item_restore*(10000+100*grade)/10000), then limit to current missing valid resource
potion_effects.healing_block: pre-existing HP block rejects HP item use before cost/cooldown; no boosted bypass, mana items unaffected by HP-only block
potion_effects.multiple_same_named_sources: one class-qualified passive source only; no repeated multiplier per potion stack

healing_martial.owner: caster positive learned allocated effective grade snapshot at accepted heal, not recipient grade
healing_martial.formula: base adopted heal amount -> floor(amount*(10000+150*grade)/10000) -> at effect apply live HP block/alive and limit missingHP
healing_martial.eligible: explicit recovery_martial_skill/HP_heal profile, including20Dongling recovery ticks; no lifesteal/HP potions/resurrection/barrier/mana
healing_martial.periodic: one cast grade snapshot kept for all valid ticks; do not multiply already boosted stored amount again each tick
healing_martial.group: same caster coefficient once independently on each legal target base amount
healing_martial.no_new_procs: magnitude modifier does not manufacture hit/crit/rage/charge events

mana_reduction.scope: instant mana payment of explicitly tagged martial skills, not all UI costs or persistent aura upkeep
mana_reduction.eligible_source: one effective learned own-class Taiji source
mana_reduction.combine_with_auxiliary: base* (10000-TaijiReduction) * (10000-strongestAuxReduction) /100000000; upward round once after product, positive result minimum1; no repeated per-source round or additive65percent cutoff
mana_reduction.blood_devil: after all ordinary reductions, explicit new martial cost override0; before affordability checks; no payment refund on already paid actions
mana_reduction.live_cost_snapshot: at accept only; later anti/unequip does not refund or increase already accepted cost
mana_reduction.named_proc_fee_exception: 甄凤柏内功联动气功.v1.json weapon_boost500 explicitly permits Taiji alone for extra passive500fee; ordinary auxiliary/blooddevil waiver not inferred

grade_policy: existing learning conditions and named20/40 caps, temporary0 contributes zero; baseline restoration still follows item/skill definition. Missing modifier source/cost profile rejects, not guessed.
persistence: store chosen cast recovery/cost snapshot and spent receipt, not another permanent base restore number. Potion quantity/effect/cooldown commit together; late block no catchup; same cast/tick replay no second heal.
